item.title: En Video: el momento del rescate con vida de un adolescente en Australia que estuvo 6 días perdido en un bosque
item.description: William había salido de campamento con un amigo cuando se perdió en una región boscosa; más de 100 rescatistas participaron del operativo que permitió encontrarlo Publicado también por: La Nación - El Mundo. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: Life-saving medicines frequently in short supply and doctors are worried
item.description: ABC analysis reveals the important medicines that are repeatedly hard to source, highlighting supply chain weaknesses that could get worse. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madi Chwasta, Jarrod Fankhauser, Joshua Byrd, and Cristen Tilley

item.title: New $76m hub helps agencies enter 'chat room' to disrupt youth extremism
item.description: A new $76 million federal counterterrorism centre will bring ASIO and the AFP together in Sydney to intercept online youth radicalisation inside gaming platforms such as Discord and Roblox. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Caisley

item.title: Overreaction, error and anger still plague Australia's sandpaper response
item.description: Usman Khawaja's revelations on Sandpapergate may have come eight years after the fact, but time has not changed Australia's response to the cricket scandal. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Russell Jackson

item.title: Could this be Australia's Bermuda Triangle?
item.description: Barrington Tops National Park in NSW has claimed nine planes and 30 lives in the past eight decades. Only four people have ever walked away, and one of those is pilot Dennis Hume, who was forced to eject from his plane and plunge thousands of metres into its unforgiving forest ranges. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keely Johnson

item.title: The government is in trouble — does Albanese have the skills to fix it?
item.description: As cost-of-living pressures fuel frustration in the Australian electorate, the shine is fading on Anthony Albanese's leadership. Will he be able to resurrect the trust he once had? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michelle Grattan

item.title: Regulator warns of 'interruptions' to business as AI models evolve
item.description: The regulator that oversees Australia's banks, super funds and insurers will run "stress tests" to examine hypothetical doomsday scenarios linked to AI, warning that firms are unprepared. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nassim Khadem

item.title: Australian activists ordered to destroy abattoir footage despite retaining copyright
item.description: Australia’s High Court has concluded that Farm Transparency International maintains copyright over clandestinely acquired footage, underscoring the ramifications of trespassing despite its public interest nature. Activists are compelled to dispose of the recordings, although third parties may share them legally. This landmark judgment will influence future activism and the interplay of copyright law, prompting legal experts to scrutinize the ramifications for the rights of undercover filming. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Australia's High Court overturns $1.346 million abuse compensation award, orders new tria
item.description: Australia’s High Court has ordered a retrial in the case concerning the estate of a convicted sexual abuser. The retrial is necessary after the first trial did not adequately address key pieces of evidence. The court clarified important legal principles related to unrepresented litigants and trial procedures. MTH, the survivor, is once again pursuing damages for the abuse she suffered while in foster care. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: From bush food to biodegradable materials: Unlocking the potential of pigface
item.description: An Australian native plant traditionally used by Indigenous communities for food and medicine could help scientists develop stronger, more flexible biodegradable film. UNSW researchers have discovered that adding extracts from pigface, Carpobrotus glaucescens, a hardy coastal succulent, to seaweed-based films can significantly improve their strength and flexibility. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Modi to visit Manila for ASEAN Summit; maritime security, trade on agenda
item.description: Modi is also set to join Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, U.S. President Donald Trump, and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi for the annual Quad summit in Manila. There is, however, no official word on the Quad summit. Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: ‘Start listening’: Indigenous activist implores Albanese to block new coal, oil and gas
item.description: Flanked by Greta Thunberg, Rikki Dank says the Australian PM must heed the calls for action on climate change An indigenous climate activist who is taking the Australian government to the UN human rights committee over its coal and gas exports stood alongside Greta Thunberg at Cop summit to demand Anthony Albanese “stop speaking and start listening.” Draped in traditional dress in front of a media throng, Rikki Dank, a Gudanji and Wakaya traditional owner, delivered an impassioned plea to Albanese to listen to “the Australian people when they say no more new coal, oil and gas”. Continue… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.
item.dc:creator: Graham Readfearn in Antalya

item.title: Manchester United sacked manager Michael Carrick
item.description: With the famous club sitting in the relegation zone, Manchester United says "a change is necessary in order to achieve our ambitions", ending the 10-month stint of the 45-year-old former midfielder. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Australia: Teen found alive after six days missing in bush
item.description: A 17-year-old Australian has been found alive and well after spending six days missing in bushland east of Melbourne. After being spotted by helicopter, the teen was winched to safety before an emotional reunion with his mother who joked that “he’s never leaving the house again”. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Who is Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy linked to Nvidia's Jensen Huang?
item.description: Footage shows Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang alongside Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman at the centre of an alleged Chinese intelligence operation targeting him. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Encontraron con vida a un adolescente con autismo que estuvo seis días perdido en un bosque de Australia
item.description: William había salido de campamento con un amigo cuando se perdió en una región boscosa; más de 100 rescatistas participaron del operativo que permitió encontrarlo Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.title: Five shot, one killed, at Washington DC gym
item.description: Panic spread through the area after the man opened fire inside a gym, continued shooting outside, then barricaded himself in an apartment about 1.5 kilometres north of the White House. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
